description.value:
You understand some of the wild hunt's techniques and can use them to form a primal bond with a trusted ally, much as members of the hunt do. You speak and understand Fey, gain darkvision, and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Additional Lore] feat for Hunting Lore.

In addition, during your daily preparations, you can choose an ally as your hunting partner. They remain so until you choose a new hunting partner. You gain a wild link aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:60] that has the aura and primal traits. While your hunting partner is in the emanation of your wild link aura, they can speak and understand Fey and gain darkvision.

value.value: expert in one of Nature, Stealth, or Survival
